additional_info.subject: Antwort: RE: Webform_incident_SiCharge D_12-01-2026_SN: MP / S9 170004121 CRM:03208000131
additional_info.body:
Good Morning,
what do you mean with ELMS ?
First of all, we can't do anything with this abbreviation and secondly, who can or has set this limit of 85kW?
Of the total maximum power fed in of 170kW, the power is automatically divided into 85kW by the charging station when two electric trucks are connected!
This is an automatic value not set by us!
Otherwise the charging station must be configured differently by a Siemens technician here on site!
Unfortunately, in the entire process, I am only the "technician and planner" who is responsible for ensuring that the trucks are on the road and transport raw materials! (I look every day to the loading station from my office with issues)
After I sent you the information for a new ticket, a short time later the loading process was interrupted at 49% and station 2 is out of service again.
As a result, we cannot transport enough raw materials to ensure a trouble-free production process!!
And now......
Is that still not enough for a troubleshooting on site?
